svg.text: The same bend, two different kink thresholds
solidcore #2785 · tests 13/14 compare a radius of curvature with the speed size_xyz / size_t / 10000
A. the same Bézier, drawn twice
identical in space: stretching the knot vector changes only the domain length T
C. the tolerance the check compares that radius with
at T = 1 the speed tolerance is 1.41e-4, above the radius: reported
at T = 50 it is 2.83e-6, below it: not reported
